# relative-time API reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/documentation.cjs. Do not edit. -->

Localized relative instants with controlled/live clocks and full-date descriptions.

## RelativeTime

Localized elapsed/remaining time with a semantic timestamp and full-date description.
Inherits typography/color: compose FormattedText or Badge instead of selecting visual variants.
Below one minute displays localized now. Days are 24 hours; months/years use clamped UTC anniversaries.
referenceTime freezes the reference; autoUpdate false samples after commit on date/mode changes.
Live mode updates at label boundaries, resynchronizes hourly and pauses in a hidden host document.
Tooltip defaults to keyboard-focusable time; no live announcements or generated inline styles.
Invalid instants render only fallback. Valid instants with invalid Intl configuration throw.
Requires native Intl locale/time-zone data; server imports are safe, hydration is not guaranteed.

### Imports

```ts
import { RelativeTime } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import { RelativeTime } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import { RelativeTime } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/relative-time';
```

### Use when

- An absolute instant should display a localized relative label and optional full-date description.

### Avoid when

- Use an explicit calendar formatter for date-only values, which are not instants.

### Examples

#### Basic usage

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { FormattedText, RelativeTime } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

<FormattedText variant="caption1" subtle>
  <RelativeTime dateTime="2026-01-01T12:00:00Z" locale="it-IT" timeZone="Europe/Rome" />
</FormattedText>;
```

#### Separate SPFx UI culture from the site time zone

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { RelativeTime, useSPFxLocaleInfo } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
// Mount under the initialized matching provider. Unknown groups have no site-zone label.
function ModifiedTime({ modified }: { modified: Date }) {
  const info = useSPFxLocaleInfo();
  return info.ianaTimeZone === undefined ? <span>Site time zone unavailable</span> :
    <RelativeTime dateTime={modified} locale={info.uiLocale} timeZone={info.ianaTimeZone} />;
}
```

#### Customize an invalid-date fallback without replacing the time ref

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { RelativeTime } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
function OptionalDate({ dateTime }: { dateTime: Date | string | number | undefined }) {
  const fallbackRef = React.useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null); // React 17's legacy ref initializer.
  return <RelativeTime dateTime={dateTime} fallback={{ ref: fallbackRef,
    children: (Component, props) => <Component {...props}>Date unavailable</Component>,
  }} />;
}
```

### Signatures

```ts
(props: RelativeTimeProps & RefAttributes<HTMLTimeElement>): ReactElement<any, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | null
```

#### Parameters

- `props`: Input instant, localization, clock/tooltip options and native time attributes.

#### Returns

A time root and description/Tooltip, or the supplied fallback for invalid input.

## RelativeTimeProps

Localized relative timestamp with a native time root and optional full-date description.
Styling is inherited; compose FormattedText or Badge for presentation. Uses native
`Intl` formatters and the host Fluent tooltip context; no SPFx provider is required.

### Imports (2)

```ts
import type { RelativeTimeProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { RelativeTimeProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { RelativeTimeProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/relative-time';
```

### Examples (2)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { RelativeTime } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
<RelativeTime dateTime="2026-01-01T12:00:00Z" locale="it-IT" format="short" />
```

### Type

```ts
interface RelativeTimeProps extends Omit<Pick<DetailedHTMLProps<TimeHTMLAttributes<HTMLTimeElement>, HTMLTimeElement>, "key" | keyof TimeHTMLAttributes<HTMLTimeElement>>, "dangerouslySetInnerHTML" | "children" | "dateTime">
```

### Members

| Member | Type | Requirement | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `RelativeTimeProps.autoUpdate` | `boolean \| undefined` | Optional | true | Refresh at label boundaries and host-document visibility resume; when omitted, defaults to `true`.<br>With `false`, sample after commit on instant/mode changes; presentation changes do not resample.<br>A supplied `referenceTime` disables this clock and its listeners. |
| `RelativeTimeProps.children` | `never` | Forbidden | — | Not supported: the formatter owns content.<br>Must be omitted or undefined in this branch. |
| `RelativeTimeProps.dangerouslySetInnerHTML` | `never` | Forbidden | — | Not supported: generated content is always React text.<br>Must be omitted or undefined in this branch. |
| `RelativeTimeProps.dateTime` | `string \| number \| Date \| undefined` | Required | — | Valid `Date`, epoch milliseconds or ISO datetime with `Z`/numeric offset.<br>Date-only, timezone-less and impossible calendar values are invalid. `undefined` or invalid input renders fallback. |
| `RelativeTimeProps.fallback` | `ContentSlot<"span">` | Optional | — | Literal content or span props/render slot for invalid date/reference, default undefined; no time root or timer. Shorthand gains no wrapper; slot ref targets the span, separate from the time root ref. Callbacks run only for invalid input. |
| `RelativeTimeProps.format` | `"long" \| "short" \| "narrow" \| undefined` | Optional | 'long' | Localized unit spelling, default long. Abbreviations depend on Intl locale data.<br>When omitted, defaults to long. |
| `RelativeTimeProps.locale` | `string \| string[] \| undefined` | Optional | — | BCP47 locale or ordered preferences; when omitted, defaults to the runtime locale. |
| `RelativeTimeProps.referenceTime` | `string \| number \| Date \| undefined` | Optional | — | Fixed reference instant, using the same validation as `dateTime`; disables timers<br>and automatic updates. When omitted, uses the local clock; invalid supplied references render fallback. |
| `RelativeTimeProps.showTooltip` | `boolean \| undefined` | Optional | true | Show a Fluent full-date description tooltip; when omitted, defaults to `true` and `tabIndex=0`<br>unless explicitly overridden. With `false`, keep a hidden full-date description without adding a tab stop. |
| `RelativeTimeProps.timeZone` | `string \| undefined` | Optional | — | Intl time zone for the full date only, default runtime zone. Invalid configuration throws for valid dates.<br>When omitted, defaults to runtime zone. |
